subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should OpenClaw wait for a redacted failed proxy request/response before choosing between another targeted sanitizer, better fallback diagnostics, docs, or a strict-minimal `openai-completions` mode?
rationale: Current source proves partial hardening and plausible request-shape mismatch, but the remaining fix direction could add new provider/config surface and cannot be chosen safely without the actual failing payload.

options.title: Wait for proxy capture
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for the OpenClaw-generated request body plus proxy status/body before selecting the narrow fix.

options.title: Sponsor strict-minimal mode
options.body: Accept the product/config surface and design an explicit minimal completions mode with docs, schema, migration expectations, and live proxy proof.

options.title: Treat as stale without capture
options.body: Close later as insufficiently reproducible only if maintainers decide the existing hardenings and docs are enough without a current-main capture.

recommendation.title: Wait for proxy capture
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for the OpenClaw-generated request body plus proxy status/body before selecting the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The live issue is assigned to `osolmaz`, so they are the best available owner for the remaining capture/product-direction choice.
